name: lithe-speaker-network-check
description: Friendly live Lithe Audio speaker and home-network support.

interface.shortDescription: Friendly live speaker and network support
interface.longDescription: Starts a real Lithe Audio case, asks exactly five key questions, checks connectivity, DHCP/IP, RF, multicast/mDNS, AP behaviour, Cast and speaker logs, correlates a probable root cause, actions one approved reversible fix and creates a redacted PDF report.
defaultPrompt: Start my live Lithe Audio speaker and network support session.
